detail: The biomarker report and NCT03467152 share one study family. The subset is not a separate clinical endpoint comparison.
The compound study examines learning and memory mechanisms. It does not report human Lewy body dementia trial symptom outcomes.
Secondary clinical review. Use its citations as discovery leads, not independent outcome evidence.
Early phase target-engagement and dose-selection study. It is not the registered phase 2 patient symptom outcome report.
Early cardiac safety and exposure modeling, not an outcome report for hallucination frequency or rest tremor.
Clinical management review. No primary phase 2 outcome data were identified in the indexed abstract.
Secondary review of herbal interventions for Alzheimer's disease or dementia. Its indexed scope does not supply a dried-sage Parkinson apathy contrast.
The abstract and publisher preview give injected rosmarinic acid in rats and an authors' interpretation of increased motivation with locomotion. Exact task measures remain open.
The computational study concerns the turmeric constituent bisdemethoxycurcumin, a different exposure.
Secondary synthesis on neuroactive constituents. It supplies no new clinical dried-sage apathy measurement in its abstract.
Common sage network predictions and molecular docking. No biological or clinical apathy outcome was observed.
Oral isolated rosmarinic acid; model-associated locomotion in mice, with no apathy response or culinary sage contrast.
Secondary review of aromatic herbs. The abstract supplies no independent sage Parkinson apathy outcome.
Review of plant exposures in menopause and neurodegeneration. The retrieved abstract gives no frozen preparation and symptom contrast.
Secondary essential-oil review; extracts and route require separate assessment. Its abstract provides no dried-sage apathy result.
